_FOLLOW_SHORT = frozenset({"ops"})


''','''
''')

            batch = page.items
            if account in _FOLLOW_SHORT and len(batch) < self.limit:
                # Fill a short page
                page = self.feed.fetch(account, cursor, self.limit * 2)
                batch = page.items
            items.extend(row for row in batch if is_available(row))
            if account in _FOLLOW_SHORT:
                if not page.next_cursor:
                    break
                cursor = page.next_cursor
            else:
                # Stop when the page is not full
                if len(batch) < self.limit or not page.next_cursor:
                    break
                cursor = page.next_cursor
''','''            page = self.feed.fetch(account, cursor, self.limit)
            items.extend(row for row in page.items if is_available(row))
            # A short page is not the end; only an empty cursor is.
            if not page.next_cursor:

            cursor = page.next_cursor
''')

def short_page_with_cursor():
    return {
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("E")), None),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["treasury", "ops", "retail"])
def test_short_page_with_cursor_follows_to_tail(account):
    feed = ScriptedFeed(short_page_with_cursor())
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available(account)
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
    assert feed.calls == [(account, None, 2), (account, "c1", 2), (account, "c2", 2)]
